label: Backsheet
definition: Outermost layer for a solar panel, protecting it from harsh, varying environmental conditions over panel lifetimes.

label: Defect
definition: An Immaterial Entity that disrupts the continuity of unit cell repetition in a solid substance.; (Elucidation) A Defect is conceptualized to be some region (or a discontinuous aggregate of regions) in a material in direct contact with a crystal, that contains or lacks material entities in a way that disrupts the repeating patterns of a perfect crystal.

label: Encapsulant
definition: Adhesive material used to hold front sheet and back sheet together. Eg., EVA, POE, etc.

label: Equipment
definition: Equipment used for a particular process/ task. In photovoltaics equiptment includes solar simulators, inverters, and imaging tools

label: Humidity
definition: A Quality that inheres in an environment depending on the quantity of water vapor in the environment.

label: quality
definition: (Elucidation) A quality is a specifically dependent continuant that, in contrast to roles and dispositions, does not require any further process in order to be realized

label: Sensor
definition: The instrument on the satellite that collects the data.
